# M2 acceptance ledger

Status: **implemented and verified on 2026-10-24**. M2 is complete and [deployed to the reference systemd service](M2-complete-deployment.md).

Scope comes from the M2 row in [the specification](../../spec.md), §§10, 12–13 and 20, and the gates in [the build plan](M2-ask-and-mcp.md). M1's accepted single-host prerequisite remains as documented in its closure ledger. M3 UI breadth and M4 transcript/calendar/enrichment work are outside M2.

## Gates and direct evidence

| Gate | Evidence and asserted behavior |
| --- | --- |
| G1 / U4, U5 | `McpTests.WriteOnlyCaptureAndUpdateUseCredentialProvenanceAndInteractiveApproval` and `AskReturnsVerifiedCitationThroughTheSameBoundedExecutor`: capture uses the stored bridge credential for provenance; asking uses the same cited-answer executor. |
| G1 / U8 | `ChatWorkflowTests.ModelWriteRemainsPendingUntilBrowserApprovesAndThenCreatesOneNote`: a model proposal has no file effect before approval; approval writes the exact note once. |
| G1 / U13 | `ChatWorkflowTests.ProviderSwitchBetweenTurnsUsesPortableHistoryAndNewBinding`: two distinct HTTP provider endpoints, old transcript delivered to the second provider, no provider continuation ID, and the first endpoint receives no second-turn request. |
| G1 / U19 | `ChatWorkflowTests.RetryingAnApprovedAppendDoesNotAppendAgain` and `RetryReplaysACommittedCreateInsteadOfCreatingItAgain`: failure after a committed effect, same-turn retry, recorded result replay, one append/revision or one created document. |
| G1 / U20, G6 | `ChatWorkflowTests.RevokingOneKeyStopsItsTurnAndReplayWhileAnotherKeyStillCompletes`: the affected turn becomes `partial:revoked`, replay is denied, and the other key completes. `TurnChatClientTests` additionally exercise reauthorization during streaming and function continuations. |
| G2 | `AskCannotExecuteAWriteEvenWhenTheProviderInventsOne` rejects the write tool. `InjectedDocumentCannotAutoApproveEvenWhenTheModelFollowsItsWriteInstruction` feeds a real retrieved injection to a malicious provider simulation with auto-approval enabled and verifies that no proposed file is written. |
| G3 | `InventedDocumentIdIsRejectedBeforeItsContentReachesTheProvider`, `FilteredAskCannotReadAnExplicitlyNamedDocumentOutsideItsFilters`, `ToolLedgerEnforcesFrozenNamesAndCumulativeLimits`, `ToolAndMetadataLimitsCannotBeResetByRepeatedCalls`, `SourcesUseCurrentAuthoritativeBytesAndExposureLimitsAreCumulative`, and `ExposureByteLimitCountsTheCompleteSerializedSourceAndRollsBackFailure`: reject unsurfaced/out-of-filter reads and cumulative tool/document/metadata/serialized-byte cap violations. |
| G4 | `ChatApprovalTests.ConcurrentApprovalsCreateOneNoteAndOneExecution`, `CreateRecoversItsStableIdentityAcrossFileAndPublicationCrashes`, and `UpdateCrashFinalizesTheOriginalRevisionWithoutApplyingItTwice`: compare-and-set claim and journal recovery preserve one effect, including crashes at temp flush, finalization and publication boundaries. |
| G5 | `KeyMayProposeButOnlyAnInteractiveSessionCanApproveOrDiscard`, `CliPairingTests.PairedSessionCanApproveAProposalButCannotAutoApproveOrPairAnotherTerminal`, and `CliConvergenceTests.Cli_PairThroughBrowserThenAskAndApproveWithoutReplacingApiKey`: ordinary keys cannot approve; a browser-paired CLI session can, with separate credential storage. |
| G7 | `McpTests.BothProtocolGenerationsEnforceMethodScopes` exercises both supported protocol versions and denies resource listing/reading to a write-only key. `OnlyApiKeysCanUseMcpAndOriginsAreChecked` excludes browser/paired sessions and invalid origins. |
| G8 | `ChatQualityEvaluationTests.RecordedProviderMeetsClaimSupportAndIrrelevantCorpusAbstentionThresholds`: real recorded chat and embedding responses, exact request/answer replay, hash-bound manual claim annotations; supported facts 30/30, unsupported sourced claims 0/10, irrelevant-corpus abstention 9/10. Every irrelevant case retrieved four passages. [Protocol, failures and limitations](../../eval/assistant/README.md). |
| G9 | Provider-switch test above; `ChatRepositoryTests.HistoryCompactionPreservesLineageAndPurgeRedactsTheSummary`; `ChatApprovalTests.RetryAfterPurgeHasOnlyRedactionMarkersAndCanStillFinish`, `ANewPurgeAfterRetryStillStopsItsNextBoundary`, and `PublicationBindsGeneratedDocumentLineageBeforeAssistantBookkeeping`: portable history, lineage-aware compaction, purge markers and the create/publication race. |
| G10 | `EventsReplayInCommittedOrderAndRestartDoesNotRerunInterruptedWork`, `AcceptedTurnSurvivesCallerCancellationAndPersistsSourcesAndReplay`, `CliAssistantTests.RetryUsesTheExistingTurnAndStartsAfterItsResumeMarker`, `AutoApprovalRequiresBrowserNoteScopeAndNoRetrievedContext`, and `SavePreviousSourcedAnswerRetainsLineageAndRequiresApprovalEvenWhenAutoApproveIsEnabled`: ordered replay without duplicate effects, observer disconnect semantics, and provenance-based approval decisions. |

## Other required contracts

- `brain ask [--deep]`, resumable `brain chat`, browser pairing and `brain mcp` are implemented. Integration tests run the actual CLI against a daemon. The bridge's default key is read-only, a more powerful key requires explicit selection, and administrator/paired credentials are rejected.
- All eight specified MCP tools, document/note resources, daily-review/topic-brief prompts, bounded/signed cursors and strict input schemas are exercised by `McpTests`. `McpBridgeTests` verify fixed destinations, replaced authorization, proxy/redirect exclusion, Access token storage/injection and notification behavior.
- All specified slash commands use the application services, including explicit `/save` and source-preserving save of a previous answer. The command scenarios in `ChatWorkflowTests`, plus `ChatSlashCommandTests`, cover syntax, deterministic execution and read-only/approval boundaries.
- Retry is idempotent, restricted to the initiating credential and latest interrupted turn, preserves spent budgets, and cannot change provider/model/endpoint/reasoning after a committed write. The tests in `ChatRetryStorageTests.cs` cover these invariants, citation-number retention and invocation ordering. Per-request provider exposure remains available after fallback, including query-embedding destinations.
- Citation markers resolve through a hash-verified, generation-bound passage map. Passage ordinal/page, exact excerpt, document ID, revision and generation are retained. Purge redacts source-derived payloads. The compatible adapter does not advertise native span citations; it uses the passage path.
- Configured reasoning is capability-gated and output limits are honored. Private reasoning is counted in context budgets without entering the portable transcript or visible answer. `ReasoningPreferenceIsCapabilityGatedAndPrivateReasoningIsNotDisplayed` and `ReasoningContinuationIsBudgetedAndCannotChangeTheFrozenPreference` cover both supported and ignored controls.

## Validation and handoff

Locked dependency restore passed. Release builds/tests used the installed .NET SDK 10.0.111, with `-m:1 -nr:false -warnaserror`. All **1,895 deterministic tests** passed across the eight test projects. The full Release run passed seven projects; after correcting one test's nullable warning and its expectation to include query-embedding manifest entries, the complete Server project passed all 297 tests. No production-code change was needed for that rerun. OpenAPI and YAML alias changes were reviewed before updating their snapshots.

The [verification artifact](evidence/m2-closure-20261024/verification.json) records per-project counts, TRX hashes, required-scenario coverage, source fingerprint and evaluation hashes. Full logs are in `artifacts/m2-final-tests/`; earlier complete runs and focused replay evidence remain in `artifacts/m2-retry-command-tests/` and `artifacts/m2-quality-tests/`. Tests marked `Category=Qualification` are excluded from the deterministic suite; the actual local-provider recording was run separately and its responses are checked by the deterministic replay test.

Pinned versions: MCP C# SDK 2.2.0; supported MCP protocol generations 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25; Microsoft.Extensions.AI 10.10.0, abstractions/OpenAI adapter 10.10.1; OpenAI .NET SDK 2.14.0. The live fixture used local vLLM 0.31.0 for chat and embeddings. No live external vendor or Cloudflare route qualification is implied by local protocol/header tests.

Operator setup is in [the CLI README](../../src/SecondBrain.Cli/README.md) and [MCP setup](M2-mcp.md). [The M3 handoff](M3-handoff.md) identifies reusable contracts and client-side invariants. No source, account, credential, configuration or stored note in the reference service was replaced by these tests.
